edition.description: The month, YYYY-MM. Without it, the latest published edition.

scope.description: all (the default), country, group (kind of business), platform, source (where the sites came from) or city.

key.description: One key of the scope: a country's two-letter code in capitals, or a group, platform, source or city slug in small letters. Without it, every key of the scope with its headline counts.
